reason: Retained evidence filled the local VM data disk below the unchanged next-run admission floor.
execution_policy: Preserve the original execution binding, operators, audits, source image and model configurations.
Retain a verified copy-on-write rollback copy of the stopped data disk before enlargement. This same-volume recovery copy is not an independent backup.
Use the installed Colima data-disk enlargement mechanism; do not delete, reformat, migrate or prune retained evidence.
Verify actual filesystem capacity and VM teardown. A larger configured number alone is not proof of usable space.
Use a separately versioned operator and execution binding before any later model call.
Record the actual storage configuration per attempt and retain its relationship to the original binding. Do not claim identical host configuration across the amendment.
Keep gameplay/model conditions unchanged. Storage-dependent latency, throughput and wall-clock comparisons across this boundary are excluded.
Preserve both first-window results. Later results are exploratory comparisons with a disclosed storage amendment, not strong rankings.
